workload.protocol_note: Bounded one-run rejection gate after the candidate missed both the correctness and speed gates in preliminary runs.

candidate.description: Capture one complete current-code token step as a reusable HIP graph. Feed the next embedding from the device argmax result and fuse the two position increments into the unchanged argmax stage-2 owner.
candidate.dynamic_state_fix: Global attention's host-selected scan bound must reserve the complete replay horizon (639 slots here); each kernel still clamps visibility with device KVLiveSpans.live_counts.

decision.reason: The corrected graph is exact but 0.4902% slower. A preliminary corrected pair was also slower (21.862435 versus 21.759527 tok/s), so the mechanism is directionally negative before a full multi-pair gate.

llamacpp_vulkan_context.finding: The Vulkan backend records graph nodes into command buffers and groups up to max_nodes_per_submit=100 before queue submission. This is per-evaluation command-buffer batching, not reuse of one token graph across changing decode state.
llamacpp_vulkan_context.implication: A persistent HIP graph is not an equivalent implementation of Vulkan's submission path; further scheduling work needs a lower-overhead within-token batching/fusion premise.

validation.red: Focused test initially failed importing the absent fused argmax/position wrapper.
